items.html: And through the coupling of Aba with Ima, and the giving of their two drops, the seven kings were clarified and corrected, and from them went out 320 sparks of dross, which were not completed in their clarification. For in every phase and degree these 320 continue to be clarified, until the end of Assiya, where there remain in them complete dross of no use whatsoever, and these are the shells. Thus the whole matter is reckoned by the 320 sparks — for that was the number of the sparks that fell within the vessels when they broke.
